result_text:
I added `analyzeLandscape` as a second name for the `updateLandscape` command. The module compiles offline, but I could not run the CLI, so the `-help` output and the report generation are unverified.

**Changes (`cli/` module):**
- `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/Commands.java`: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and description ("Analyzes or creates a Sokrates landscape report … The landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as updateLandscape"). It is listed in the no-argument usage overview, with the same landscape options, right before `updateLandscape`.
- `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/CommandLineInterface.java`: `run()` dispatches both names to the same `updateLandscape` method. That method now takes the command name and description as parameters, so `-help` prints the usage under the name the user typed. The behaviour for both names is otherwise identical.

**Not done:**
- **README:** it has no command descriptions at all (only build and Docker notes), so there was nothing to update. I did not add a new command section. Tell me if you want one.
- **Verification:** the sandbox refused to run `java -cp ...` for the CLI, so I could not check the `analyzeLandscape -help` output or the generated landscape folder. The `cli` module has no tests. Running `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` and `analyzeLandscape -help` once would settle it.

Nothing was committed.
